MEMORANDUMOFAGREEMENT THIS MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT("Memorandumof Agreement")is dated this York not-for-profit corporation, having an address at 948 Fulton Street, Brooklyn, New York 11238 ("Owner") and FULTON 18 LLC , a New York limited liability company having an address at 277 Northern Boulevard, 1st Floor, Great Neck, NY 11021 ("Developer"). 1. ) The parties executed a Development Agreement, dated as of March /, 2022 (the "Agreement)pertaining to theProperty(defined inparagraph 3below).  2. Capitalized terms, not otherwise defined herein, shall have the meanings ascribed to such terms in the Agreement. Brooklyn,NewYork 11238,alsoknown asBlock 2014 Lot 18 on the TaxMap of theCity of New York, which is more particularly described on Schedule A attached hereto (the "Property"). 4.The Agreement provides that the conveyance of title ("Closing") will take place on (i) the date that is on or about ten (1o) Business Days following the date that Developer received notice that Owner has received either the AG Approval or Court Approval or (ii) such other later time or date, or both, as are agreed to in writing by Owner and Developer. 5. The Agreement also provides that, under certain circumstances, Owner shall be entitled, at Developer's sole cost and expense, to terminate the Agreement and undo or reverse the conveyance and other transactions contemplated thereby. 6. Owner agrees that, except as permitted by and subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, it shall not sell, convey, assign, encumber or lease all or any part of the Property and shall not voluntarily take any actions, directly or indirectly,which would or might adversely affect, in any way, the title to the Property prior to, or following, the Closing. 7. Developer agrees that, pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, Developer shall (i) rehabilitate and develop the Property,(ii) subject the same to a plan for condominium ownership consisting of two (2) units (i.e.,the Church Unit and the Developer Unit,as each is defined below), and (i) convey the Church Unit, fully renovated in accordance with the Church Unit Detailed Specifications, to the Owner for no cash consideration.

8. Developer further agrees that, subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, Developer,without the prior written consent of Owner (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld,delayedorconditioned),Developershallnotsell,assign,license,transfer,convey,leaser otherwise dispose of all or any portion of the Property, or any of Developer's interests therein, except pursuant to a mortgage or assignment of leases and rents to secure any Building Loan; 9.The purpose of thisMemorandum of Agreement is to give notice of the Agreement and therightscreated thereby,all ofwhich arehereby confirmed,and thisMemorandum ofAgreement is subject to all of the terms, conditions, provisions, covenants and agreements contained in said Agreement, all of which are incorporated herein by reference. 10. This Memorandum of Agreement shall completely replace and supersede any and all prior memorandums recordedwith respect to theAgreement. [SIGNATUREPAGEFOLLOWS]
